{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS243 |prevtitle=No Armaldo Is an Island |nextcode=PS245 |nexttitle=Bravo, Vibrava |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon VIII |subtitle=Fighting Spirit |title_ja=VS カイオーガ & グラードン VIII |title_ro=VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII |image=PS244.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 244 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|20}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 244 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|20}} |location={{rt|121|Hoenn}} }} '''The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon VIII''' (Japanese: '''VS カイオーガ & グラードン VIII''' ''VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII''), titled '''VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 244th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 64th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Fighting Spirit''' (Japanese: '''戦う意志のもとに''' ''Battle As One'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Battle As One''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On top of the wreckage of the [[Submarine Explorer 1]], a startled {{adv|Amber}} wakes up. He remembers the last words [[Archie]] told him before locking him in the Submarine Explorer 1 and sending it to the bottom of the water. Amber immediately shakes it off as a misunderstanding and goes to help his teammates raise the sea level. Elsewhere, [[Blaise]] and [[Tabitha]] continue traveling on {{rt|121|Hoenn}}, where they are joined by [[Courtney]]. At {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}'s location, it continues to easily overpower [[Brawly]] and [[Roxanne]] with its attacks. After defeating Brawly's {{p|Machoke}}, Groudon attempts to leave the battle. Roxanne immediately stops its movements with her {{TP|Roxanne|Nosepass}}'s {{m|Block}}. Although not her style of battling, Roxanne has her Pokémon continuously attack Groudon, preventing it from fighting back. Suddenly, a voice from above praises Roxanne's skills and sends out a {{p|Sealeo}} to attack Groudon with {{m|Ice Ball}}. The voice is revealed to be that of [[Wallace]], who came to help them stop Groudon. Before they can continue, three figures arrive and tell the [[Gym Leader]]s that if they intend on stopping Groudon, they'll have to face them first. ==Major events== * {{adv|Amber}} awakens and goes to help his teammates. * [[Brawly]] and [[Roxanne]] continue battling {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}. * [[Wallace]] arrives to help stop Groudon. * [[Tabitha]], [[Blaise]], and [[Courtney]] come to stop Brawly, Roxanne, and Wallace. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Roxanne]] * [[Brawly]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Archie]] (flashback) * {{adv|Amber}} * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} * [[Tabitha]]/{{tt|Mitch|Chuang Yi}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Nosepass}} ({{OP|Roxanne|Nosepass}}) * {{p|Graveler}} ([[Roxanne]]'s) * {{p|Hariyama}} ({{OP|Brawly|Hariyama}}) * {{p|Machoke}} ([[Brawly]]'s) * {{p|Luvdisc}} (Elizabeth; [[Wallace]]'s) * {{p|Sealeo}} (Richard; [[Wallace]]'s) * {{p|Pelipper}} ({{adv|Amber}}'s) * {{p|Swellow}} ([[Blaise]]'s) * {{p|Armaldo}} ([[Blaise]]'s) * {{p|Swellow}} ([[Courtney]]'s) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 蓋歐卡&固拉多 VIII|VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII}} (Taiwan)
